title: Installment Terms
intro: Below are the requirements for arranging an installment, the general installment terms, and the conditions of partner banks.

eligibility.title: Requirements for arranging an installment
eligibility.description: To arrange an installment, you must meet the following requirements:

items.citizen: Be a citizen of the Republic of Armenia
items.employment: Be a registered employee or have a clean credit history
items.documents: Have a passport, social card, or ID card
items.foreign: Foreign citizens must provide a certificate of registered address
items.online: Online installment arrangement is also available — you can complete it from your preferred location without visiting the store

generalTerms.title: Provided installment terms
generalTerms.description: General terms may vary depending on the selected bank and the customer’s details.

items.interest: 0–12% interest rate (depending on the preferred bank)
items.serviceFee: Account service fee: monthly from 1% of the total value, depending on the selected bank

partnerBanks.title: Partner banks
partnerBanks.description: Installments may be arranged through the following partner banks. Final terms are confirmed by the bank.

disclaimer.title: Important notice
disclaimer.description: Dear customer, please note that the payment schedule confirmed by the bank at the time of calculation and on-site installment arrangement may differ slightly depending on personal details.

contact.title: For more details
contact.description: For more details, call 093-44-44-94 or 055-81-11-81, or visit our store.

items.nominalRate: Annual nominal interest rate — 21.6% per year without service fee
items.commission: Loan commission — 0% monthly of the contractual loan amount
items.interestCalc: Interest calculation — daily on the declining loan balance

items.serviceFee: Commission — during loan servicing, a monthly account service fee of 0–1% of the loan balance is charged. In case of early repayment, it is reduced proportionally

items.age: Limit requests may be made by persons aged 18–70
items.term: Loan term via the “Installment on the spot” system — 12–36 months
items.lateFee: Overdue obligations — a penalty of 0.13% of the overdue amount is charged for each day of delay

items.age: Limit requests may be made by men aged 20+ and women aged 18+
items.nominalRate: Nominal loan interest rate (depending on cooperation terms with the retailer) — 0%–21.4%
items.term: Loan term in months (depending on cooperation terms with the retailer) — 3–60 months
items.penalty: In case of non-performance of obligations, penalties on overdue loan and interest — 0.13% for each overdue calendar day

items.regulation: The bank is supervised by the Central Bank

items.borrower: Borrower — RA resident individuals aged 20+, whose age during loan servicing will not exceed 65
items.clientFee: Customer commission calculated monthly on the initial principal — 0%
